description: This file defines an Android activity for onboarding screens in a Kotlin-based Android app. It includes setup for view pager, indicators, and navigation buttons, as well as data classes and adapters for onboarding slides.

classes.name: OnboardingActivity
classes.description: Main activity handling onboarding screens with ViewPager2, indicator dots, and navigation buttons.

classes.name: OnboardingSlide
classes.description: Data class representing each onboarding slide with an image, title, and description.

classes.name: OnboardingAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter to bind onboarding slide data to views within the ViewPager2.

classes.name: OnboardingAdapter.ViewHolder
classes.description: ViewHolder for the onboarding slides, holding references to UI components.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up ViewPager2, indicators, and buttons.

methods.name: setupViewPager
methods.description: Assigns adapter to ViewPager2 and registers page change callback.

methods.name: setupButtons
methods.description: Configures skip and next buttons for navigation and completion.

methods.name: setupIndicators
methods.description: Creates indicator dots based on slides and adds them to the container.

methods.name: updateIndicators
methods.description: Updates the visual state of indicator dots based on the selected page.

methods.name: updateButtons
methods.description: Changes the text of the Next button depending on the page position.

methods.name: finishOnboarding
methods.description: Marks onboarding as completed and starts the main activity.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Function inside ViewHolder to bind slide data to UI components.
